js: (()=>{const el=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,'我们回到之前的界面问题继续聊'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'typed';})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-t0<45000){const m=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); if(m){const d=document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); return JSON.stringify({found:true,kindText:(d?d.innerText:'').slice(0,600),hasOriginal:(d?d.innerText:'').includes('我们回到之前的界面问题继续聊')});} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return JSON.stringify({found:false,tail:document.body.innerText.slice(-600)});})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-t0<60000){const modal=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); const body=document.body.innerText; if(!modal&&body.includes('已切回界面问题的话题')){const ta=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); const send=document.querySelector('button.send-btn'); let ctx=null; try{ctx=await (await fetch('/api/session/context')).json();}catch(e){} return JSON.stringify({modalGone:true,answered:true,draft:ta?ta.value:null,sendDisabled:send?send.disabled:null,topic:ctx?{id:ctx.topic_id,name:ctx.topic_name}:null,messages:ctx?ctx.messages.length:null});} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));} return JSON.stringify({modalGone:!document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'),answered:document.body.innerText.includes('已切回界面问题的话题'),tail:document.body.innerText.slice(-800)});})()

(()=>{const el=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,'这段内容看起来属于量子计算实验，帮我切过去'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'typed';})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-t0<45000){const m=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); if(m){const d=document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); return JSON.stringify({found:true,content:(d?d.innerText:'').slice(0,600)});} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return JSON.stringify({found:false,tail:document.body.innerText.slice(-600)});})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-t0<60000){const modal=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); const body=document.body.innerText; if(!modal&&body.includes('就留在当前话题继续回答')){const ta=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); const send=document.querySelector('button.send-btn'); let ctx=null; try{ctx=await (await fetch('/api/session/context')).json();}catch(e){} let topics=null; try{topics=await (await fetch('/api/graph/topics')).json();}catch(e){} return JSON.stringify({modalGone:true,answered:true,draft:ta?ta.value:null,sendDisabled:send?send.disabled:null,topic:ctx?{id:ctx.topic_id,name:ctx.topic_name}:null,messageCount:ctx?ctx.messages.length:null});} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));} return JSON.stringify({modalGone:!document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'),answered:document.body.innerText.includes('就留在当前话题继续回答'),tail:document.body.innerText.slice(-800)});})()
